de.name: Abducken

en.name: Dodge
en.description: For 5...11 seconds, you move 33% faster and have a 27...75% chance to block incoming projectiles. Dodge ends if you attack.
en.concise: (5...11 seconds.) You move 33% faster and have 27...75% chance to block projectile attacks. <gray>Ends if you attack.</gray>
